resolutionSource.strategy: Resolve the three Watchdog file conflicts as one isolated operational change by preserving the complete Workshop episode protocol and decayed transport retry implementation.

coveredBoundaries: final and final_answer are both terminal transcript phases
exit zero without a current visible final and matching episode Ack is not accepted as recovery
resumed-progress, safe-blocked, completed, and reentry-noop stop retries
transport-only failures use 5/10/15/30/60/120 minute decayed backoff
the third transport failure is not an immediate circuit break
permissions, worktree branch, active turn, pending tool call, and recovery episode are checked before accepting recovery

nonClaims: This is not a formal m1 integration.
The Workshop Watchdog commits remain excluded from the W1 business cherry-pick sequence.
A LaunchAgent exit code alone is not recovery evidence.
No recovery attempt or user-visible recovery claim occurred in this active episode.
